rnam 'gyur dag

/'dzum pa'i gzugs su bsgyur nas gdong gi ngos// rings pa nyid lhags sku drin mtshungs med de// su zhig skad du gleng zhing blta ba bzhin// 'di na lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// skyabs gcig gtsug gi nor bu

mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub sku gshegs pa'i skabs yin pas/ rin chen de// bsod nams thag pa dman pas ma chings par// sa bcu'i byang sems dbus su yud kyis shor// kye ma mngon par mtho dang nges legs kyi// lam mkhan sgron me de ni gang du thal// sngon las zong gis bsgrubs pa'i nor bu de// skye 'di nyid la ji ltar thob 'gyur grang*// gzhan du dam pa rnams kyi thugs rje yi// 'chi ba med pa'i bcud len 'thungs mthong nas// 'byung tshogs lus la 'tshe ba'i bar chad bgegs// phrag dog dbang gis yul gzhan rnam par 'khyams// de tshe rgyal ba'i gsung gi dgongs 'grel gyi// brda don lhag chad dag par byed pa'i blo// ma rig mdza' bos phung du zin na yang*// zog rdzun snying gi phugs su 'tshang ba'i skabs// slad kyi char yang bstan dang 'gro ba yi// dge legs rin chen bye ma rgyun mi chad// 'grems pa'i phrin las gaṅgā klung gi rgyun// 'bebs mkhas sku yi ri bo brtan pa dang*// ye shes gzigs pa'i spyan ni snying rje yis// dkyus su ring por bsrings pa'i khongs de nas// bdag lus skyed byed mas mtshon 'gro ba rnams// thugs rjes mi gtong bslab 'os mchid kyang stsol// de skad gsol ba stong min spyan zur dag /reg pa'i rten bcas snyan dngags glur blangs pa// rkang pa drug ldan 'dam skyes tshal 'jug tshe// 'gram pa'i rnga chung brdung ba bas kyang snyan// skyabs 'og la gnas bande tshul rin can// dad gus zhu tshig ma lī ka yi phreng*// don grub lo yi yid 'phrog lus brgyan te// chu stod nya ba'i lam du zhugs nas thal// zhes mkhan po rin po che sangs rgyas dpal bzang zhal sngar phul ba'i zhu yig ma lī ka'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'dren mchog dam pa'i legs gsungs kyi bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa'o//

// ༄༅// oṃ swasti bi dza yantu/ skyabs gsum mtshan gyi rol mo su zhig gis// brdung tsam nyid nas rgud pa kun bcom ste// bde legs gsar pa'i mdza' bo 'gugs byed pa// dkon mchog gsum gyis legs pa'i dpal kun stsol// phan dang bde ba kun gyi 'byung gnas lung rtogs bstan pa dam pa'i chos// yongs su bzung nas legs par smra la 'jigs bral legs pa'i blo gros can// sa skya pa zhes grags pa'i 'phrin yig phyogs kyi dga' ma'i 'gram pa la// 'dri ba'i skyes mchog de dag 'di na shis pa'i me tog stsol la spyon// grangs med bskal pa'i thog ma nyid nas byang chub 'bras bu smin gyur kyang*// thun mong 'gro ba'i snang ngo tsam du skal bar mnyam pa'i skur bzhengs nas// 'dul ba mdo dang sngags gzhung rgya mtsho'i pha rol son nas legs smra bas// 'gro ba rang rang lam dang 'bras bur legs sbyor bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// gsang chen chos kyi rnga chen brdung la 'gran med ngagaṃ gi dbaṃng phyug nyid// bgrang du med pa'i bsod nams kyis bskyed mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon zhes// mtshan nyid kun ldan lung dang rig pa'i dpang po des ni khyod nyid du// brtags nas kuṃn du dgaṃ' bas 'bod snyam leṃgs paṃ'i 'byuṃng gnaṃs rgyal gyur cig /sna tshogs las kyi lag pa'i stang stabs kyis// bris pa min par mtshan gyi gzi 'od stong*// ring por snang ba'i sku ni ma btegs pa// thub dbang bstan pa'i rgyan du lham mer snang*// yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs las 'phos pa'i chos// 'dzad mi shes par 'byung ba smra ba'i dbang*// kun gyis ngag gi dpal rnams ma byin par// blangs pa yin snyam blo ni 'phyang mo nyug /skyes dang sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis dag pa'i thugs// dri med de na shes bya'i chos rnams kun// shar ba 'di yis grangs med mkhas pa'i yid// lan brgyar 'phrog 'di chos la 'os sam ci// re ba skong byed zhing pa rnams kyi yid// dbyar rnga lhod por ldir ba'i chu ldan mas// mngon 'dod ldan pa bsam 'phel nor gyi bus// ris bral 'gro 'di khyod kyi yon tan gyis// bstan dang 'gro la sman pa'i phrin las bzang*// kun khyab mtha' las brgal ba rnam par thar// mthong ba'i tshe na sngon byung sred med bus// sa gsum gom pas bcal ba'i ngo mtshar 'gog

/mkhas par 'os pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yis// sngon med bde dang skyid pa'i khengs ldan grogs// 'jig rten kun gyi bsod nams khang pa na// khugs pa 'di yang khyod kyi drin du bsams// gnas skabs 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsal ba dang*// mi mthun rgud pa bcil ba kho na yis// nor bu tog gi blo gros dang mtshungs las// mchog gi go 'phang sbyin pas khyad par byas// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mdzod las phyogs re ba'i// ri mo yid kyi ngos su bris nas ni// lus kun sa la btud pa'i phyag dang mnyam// dngos 'byor yid kyi mchod pa tshar du dngar// skye ba'i phreng bar yongs bsags sdig ltung rnams// bshung zheng bsdams pa'i sems kyis mthol ba dang*// skye 'phags dge ba'i lag 'gro'i grong khyer la// rab dga'i 'dzum ni zla 'od lta bus bran// legs gsungs lam gyis phongs pa'i sems can la// zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi 'gyed pa dang*// lus can bsod nams brtsegs pa'i khri 'phang du// zhabs zung bskal pa'i bar du brtan par gsol// de las byung ba'i legs byas chu yi gter// yongs su bsngo ba'i srub shing mandā ras// mngon par bsrubs pa'i 'bras bu bla med kyi// byang chub zla ba'i cha shas gang bar shog /khyod zhabs rtsa lag 'tsho ltar dmar ba'i mthil// rtsibs stong 'khor lo'i re khā bris pa gang*// lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug na 'degs pa la// bsnyengs pa mi mnga' seng ge'i khri drung der// dal ba'i rten gyi mtho ris rdzing bu nas// thal sbyar padma'i 'dab ma ldem pa'i rtser// nyams 'gyur ngag gis rab gsol rkang drug glu// len pa 'dis kyang mkhas rnams mi dgyes med// ces mchod par brjod cing yan lag bdun pa'i tshig sbyor gyi me tog cung zad cig mngon par gtor nas/ skabs su bab par gsol ba/ deng gi dus kyi lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa kun gyis mchod pa'i 'os su gyur pa/

phyi kun du spyod pa zhi zhing dul ba'i dpal ni ston pa'i 'khor gyi dgra bcom pa chen po'i rnam pa la/ nang gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i ngo bor bzhugs pa/ gang gi mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan padma'i tshal gyi dri bsung lta bu de nyid kyis/ nged cag gi phar gyur pa'i sa spyod stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba la gcig tu 'dun pa'i chos rgyal chen po gang de gtso bor smos pa'i bdag cag rnams kyi yid dbang bung ba dag ni phyogs ga la ba der yongs su drangs par brten/ ljongs 'dir spyan 'dren gyi tshig ni 'di skad du mchid pa thos te/ dper na glang po'i mchog cig 'dul mkhan pa dag gi thabs kyis legs par dul bar byas pa de/ kha lo pa su yang rung ba zhig gis 'dod pa'i lam ni gang dang gang du drangs pa'i sa der mi rgyu ba med pa de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' snying rjes shin tu mnyen par byas pa nyid ni/ gzhan don phra mo zhig gi ched du yang dpag tshad mang po dag gi pha rol du mi bzhud pa mi mnga' na/ sems can tshad med cing grangs med pa dag gi don du lta ci smos te/ rgyan las/ rgyal sras brtson 'grus mchog la brten pa de// sems can tshogs rab smin par byed pa na// pha rol sems dge gcig gi phyir yang ni// bskal pa bye ba stong du'ang skyo mi 'gyur// zhes so// des na bstan pa dar ba'i yul gru chen po rnams kyi nang nas bod chen por grags pa'i mdo smad phyogs kyi sa'i cha/ sngon byung ba grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po la sogs pa mkhas shing grub pa'i sa la gnas pa mang pos byon cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gdan sa/ sde bzhi dang dge ba bcu la sogs pa chos dang srid pa'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pas mngon par gtams pa'i rgyal khab 'di nyid kyis thog drangs/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par bya ba dang*/

sems can kun gyi bsod nams phung po rnam par spel bar bya ba dang*/ khyad par kho bo cag la sogs pa'i gdul byar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i lam dang 'bras bu'i dpal gyi skal ba bzang po la sbyar ba'i slad du cis kyang 'byon par gsol ba 'debs so zhes bya ba la sogs pas snga phyir ji ltar gsol ba btab pa de ltar zhal gyis bzhes nas ljongs 'dir legs par phebs/ mthong ba don gyi 'bras bus mngon par lci ba'i mtshan bzang ldan pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ni dngos su mjal/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i legs par gsungs pa'i bdud rtsi zad mi shes pa'i dga' ston ni ngoms par stsal/ chos kyi dam tshig zab mo mi phyed rdo rje'i zung thag gis ni lu gu rgyud du sbrel/ khyad par du gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyis gtsos pa'i chos sde che phra rnams su 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas dbang bskur ba dang gdams pa ston pa la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ni rgya chen po bskor/ sgrub cing mchod pa'i rgyun chen po 'dzugs pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas bstan pa spyi dang bye brag rje btsun sa skya pa chen po brgyud par bcas pa'i lugs srol ni phyogs thams cad nas nam langs pa la nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od kyis yongs su bran pa bzhin du byas/ mi shes pa dang the tshom gyi drwa ba rnams ni dral/ chos kyi snang ba rnams kyis ni phyogs kun du snang bar byas/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa dag ni lag rtser yod pa ltar gyur/ mdor na deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i go 'phang mchog tu son par ma gyur gyi bar du skad cig kyang 'bral mi phod par bsten pa la ni spro ba phyir zhing je cher song*/ de lta na'ang 'di lor chibs kyi kha lo yul dbus su cis kyang mi bsgyur thabs med yin tshul gyi gsung mchid lan mang du stsal ba rnams kyis/

chos kyi rigs las skyes pa bdag cag rnams kyi snying la tsher ma'i reg bya bzhin du rtsub par gyur kyang*/ rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas phyir bshol ba'i thabs ni rtsom ma phod pa de bzhin lags/ 'dir skabs su bab pa ni spyir bla ma'i sku drin gsob pa la ni stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams 'dzam bu gser gyi phye mas phyur bur gtams kyang mi 'tsho bas ni/ ji skad du/ gaṅgā'i bye snyed rin chen gser dag gis// bkang ste gang la sbyin pa phyin pa bas// dus ngan tshe na tshigs bcad gcig brjod pa// de yis phan 'dogs ci 'dra de la med// ces tshigs bcad gcig gis phan 'dogs bgyis pa'i drin tshad gzhal du med par bstan na/ zab cing rgya che'i gdams pa'i rgya mtsho stsal ba'i mchog gi rdo rje'i slob dpon gyi sku drin la tshad du btub pa ci zhig de lta na'ang deng 'dir tshogs bsags phebs rdzongs kyi dngos po'i maṇḍal 'bul mtshon/ thog mar bkra shis pa'i kha dar sogs bris so// tshan grangs bcas brgya phrag bdun lhag cig phyag gi phreng ba bsgrigs pa dang chab cig par dbul ba bgyi lags so// slar smras pa/ phyogs bcu'i rnam par 'dren kun mgrin gcig tu// rab snyan dbyangs kyi rgyud mangs stong 'khrol bas// bsngags pa'i yul mchog rdo rje'i slob dpon la// mchod par brtsam 'di skal ba mi chung grang*// tshe 'di nyid dang skye ba'i phreng bar bcas// dwangs pa'i chu dang zla gzugs ji bzhin du// 'bral med rtag par rgyud la ye shes kyi// gzigs pa dam pa'i byin rlabs gzhug tu gsol// 'jig rten pa dag mthong ba'i chos kyi phun tshogs dag la sred pas smon// ngag gi mthu ldan drang srong 'ga' zhig sdang zhen gyis myos smon lam bor// slob 'bangs bdag ni gnas skabs bde 'byor zhar la 'dren cing gzhan don du// byang chub snying po rmi 'dra nyid du smon pa 'di ni don yod mdzod// ces pa 'di ni gnas gsar ba ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dbus su gdan bteg skabs/

sa skyong bla ma kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde nyid nas phebs rdzongs 'bul chen gyi gong bshad du mchod brjod dang gleng ba mdor bsdus bcas pa'i 'bul yig rkang drug mgrin rnga zhes bya ba 'di ltar bris shig ces bka' stsal me tog gtsug tu lhung skabs/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis sug bris su bgyis pa dza yantu// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yantu/ phyogs bral zhing gi chos rnga che rnams kyi// mi zad yon tan mtha' dag srid pa 'dir// rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi rnam rol gyis// sems can smin byed bla mas rtag tu skyongs// sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las rjes skyong ba// bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan gyis spa ba'i sku// lus can yongs kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag tu// bskal pa'i phreng bar mi shigs rtag pa'i ched// mi 'jigs bzhi mtshon gdong lnga ldan pa dag /mngon par rgyags pas bsgyings pa'i rkang stegs ni// legs bris dbang po dang bcas 'jig rten gyi// thor tshugs nor bus bteg pa ga la bar// thal sbyar me tog bandu dzi ba kas// lan brgyar sa la reg pa'i phyag dang mnyam// zhu ris bung ba myos pa'i dbyangs chung 'bul// lus can byang chub mchog tu smin mdzad pa'i// phrin las mnga' ba dpal ldan chos kyi rje// skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog rin chen gsum// gcig tu 'dus pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal// khyod zhabs shis pa'i 'khor los mtshan pa'i rdul// dri med kyis btab ljongs kyi thig le 'di// deng nas brtsams te mngon dga'i zhing gi dpal// 'di na yongs su 'phos pa yin snyam bgyid// deng dus 'jig rten 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// spyi nor gcig pu nyid du bzhugs gyur kyang*// bka' yi slob 'bangs kho bo ltos bcas kyi// skyabs su thob 'di ngo mtshar skal ba bzang*// khyad par lus med thul gyi rten gsum phreng*// ji snyed phra rab rdul gyi go rer yang*// mtha' yas rgyal ba'i zhing du mngon sprul pa'i// bka' drin srid pa'i rin gyis gzhal du ci// 'on te bsod nams rjes mthun 'byor pa'i mtsho// rtse gcig dad pa'i sor rtses nyer btus pa'i// zang zing 'byor pa'i me tog nyung zad cig

/yon du stob pa'i rnam grangs 'di ltar lags// de'ang thog mar bkra shis pa'i lha dar sogs rnam grangs brgya phrag la gsum gyis lhag pa phul bar dgyes par bzhes nas 'di phyi kun du thugs rje'i gzigs pa mi g.yel ba'i bka' drin yangs pa'i rwa ba las mi 'dor bar mkhyen mkhyen/ slar smras pa/ dpag yas zhing gi rgyal ba mchod pa bas// gang gi ba spu'i sgo rer ri mor bgyis// bsod nams mchog tu thub pas rab bsngags pa// yul mchog mchod 'di skal ba mi dman grang*// 'bras ldan dus kyi zla gzhon padma'i rtsa// kha ba'i rdul brtsegs ltar dkar dge ba'i tshogs// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs kyi chu skyes dag /'jig rten kun gyi bla na brtan phyir bsngo// kho bo ltos bcas kyis mtshon 'gro ba rnams// byang chub bar gyi skye bar dal 'byor ldan// dam pas rjes bzung rnam dag chos la brten// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa chos sde bsam 'grub pho brang nas bka' 'bangs bsod nams rgyal mtshan khu tshas phul/ zhes pa 'di'ang tshul rin gyis so// // ༄༅// bcu phrag shes bya'i yul la 'jug pa'i mkhyen dpyod 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i rjes su song ba'i chos kyi rgyal po gang de'i zhabs zung shis pa'i re khās spa ba'i rkang stegs dam pa chos kyis mngon par mtho ba ga la bar/ gus pa'i yid mtsho las btus pa'i tshig gi me tog 'thor ba/ ring nas zab cing yangs pa'i chu gter chen po rgyal sras spyod pa'i snying stobs mi dman lha dbang rtsal gyis bsrubs pa las nye bar 'phos pa/ ngur smrig 'chang ba mchog gi mi sbyin skyes nyid/ rnam 'dren bstan pa'i legs bris lam na mngon par rgyu tshe/ phyi nang gtsug lag gi 'dab stong dga' tshal bye ba cig car sngon med 'dzum pa brgya phrag grol bar mdzad pa nas/ bka' lung dri za'i lus phras phyag rgya'i mkhur tshos mdzes pa ngom pa dang lhan cig

srid na shin tu dkon cing byin rlabs 'dod pa 'jo ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel nyungs 'bru lta bu dang*/ sngags btab srung ba rdo rje'i gur khyim dam rdzas 'chi med gsos sman gyi phon po bcas stsal ba rnams spyi bo'i stegs la ngal gsor spyod pa'i 'phral la/ yon tan rten gyur dang po'i sa la reg pa'i dga' ba gya nom min pa gzhan gyis dper mtshon tsam yang bskal par btsal bas rnyed pa'i re ba ci zhig 'dir gus ldan pa'ang nye zhos dben par ci bder mchis lags/ mtshams zhus/ bka' lung rna ba'i bcud len ji ltar phebs bzhin/ legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyi klog thabs rnam gsal sgron ma can zhig bris nas phul ba 'di/ sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi klog tshul dang brda sprod kyi gzhung mi 'gal bar bshad pa dper brjod bcas kyis gsal bar byas pa nyung ngu 'di tsam gyis gzhan la 'gre nus par sems shing*/ lar rgya gar ba lta bu'i lce bde mo bod la med pa'i dbang gis/ yi ge brtsegs pa'i mgo can rnams ma phral na ni yi ge gcig gi sgra las mi 'byung*/ phral na ni yi ge srog ldan gnyis kyi sgrar 'don pa zhig 'byung bas ci yang ma bde bar sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang thog mar ā li kā li nas brtsams te slob dpon mkhas pa'i ngag nas kha mig 'dris par yun ring du bslab gsungs pa'ang 'di dag la dgongs par mngon/ 'on kyang dkyus na bris ltar yi ge rnams kyi skye ba'i gnas dang byed pa dang rtsol ba sogs la nges par gyur na sgra zur 'don lugs phal cher des rtogs dgos shing*/ gzhan gshin rje'i gshed kyi hrīḥṣṭ+ri lta bu'ang ṣa la ṭa btags pa'i yi ge gcig yin pa la 'don pa'i tshe yang ṣi dang ṭir lta bu so sor phral te mi 'don par/ ṛ ṭu ra ṣa spyi bo las// zhes byung ba ltar/ ṣi dngos su mi 'don par spyi bo nas 'byung zhing lce'i steng nas 'byin pa'i tshul gyis ṭira'i sgra dngos su 'don pa'o// de bzhin du sa'i mgo can ska lta bu la/

l̥ tu la sa so las 'byung zhes 'byung ba ltar sa dngos su mi 'don par lce rtse dang nye ba'i so las 'byin pa'i tshul du so bar nas si'i sgra dang bcas te ka'i sgra dngos su 'don pa'o// sha sogs la'ang des 'gre'o// yang tshe gzungs kyi puṇya zhes pa 'greng bu can dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i su po ṣyo la'ang*/ sna ldan sde pa rang rang gi gnas dang sna las rab tu 'byung*/ zhes pa ltar ṇe'i sgra so dang sna las 'byin pa'i tshul gyis ye'i sgra cung zad 'don pa dang*/ ṣo yo la'ang ṣa'i sgra gong ltar 'don pa'i tshul gyis yo'i sgra gsal bar 'don pa'o// yang na/ gsal byed srog med phyi ma'i mgor// brtsegs sam mtha' rten yar sbyar la// de 'og rnams ni dkyus bzhin bklag /ces pa ltar ṇa snga mar sbyar la puṇa ye dang*/ su to ṣa yo lta bur bklag kyang klog thabs mkhas pa rnams kyi dgongs pa yin pas 'di gnyis gang ltar byas kyang mi 'thad pa med mod kyi/ ṣṭir la ṣa ṭa ri dang*/ ṣi ṭi ri zer ba dang*/ puṇye la pu ṇa ye dang*/ puṇa ṇe ye zer ba dang*/ ṣyo la ṣa yo zer ba sogs ni rgyu mtshan med par smras pa'o// gzhan yang gcod mtshams nor ba'i skyon 'byung ba ni/ dper na rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs las/ sarba kle sha kṣa yaṃ ka ri ye zhes pa ni/ sarba thams cad/ kle sha nyon mongs/ kṣa yaṃ zad pa/ ka ri ye byed pa zhes pa'i don la 'jug mod/ sarba kle zhes yar bcad/ sha mar sbyar te/ sha kṣa yaṃ ka ri zhes pa don ci yang min par 'gro ba sogs skyon du 'gyur ba mang po 'byung bas/ de dag la sngon gyi mkhas pas bsgrigs pa'i skad dod rnams la 'dris pa dang*/ zhib par brda sprod gzhung la sbyang bstar song ba ma gtogs 'dir 'dri bas ma ldang yang*/ rgya chen chos kyi spyan ldan dam pa nyid lta bu'i mkhyen rab kyi me long la ni mi 'char ba ci zhig gzhan dag la ni 'di tsam gyis don grub par sems so// slad kyi char yang stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bstan pa'i dpal du gsang gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du 'tsho la gzhes pa dang*/

gus ldan pa'ang mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rwa ba las mi bskyud pa'i brdar legs gsungs bdud rtsi'i dbyangs kyi 'bab stegs kyang stsal bar mkhyen mkhyen/ zhu yig chu skyes kyi rdzing bur chos kyi 'dren byed ngang pa'i bu mos 'jug pa'i mtshon byed lha dar dkar po/ gser zho/ dngul dkar bal po'i dong tse dgu bcas/ rnam byung lo'i gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes dge bar/ lhun grub steng nas gus ldan tshul khrims rin chen gyis phul ba'i zhu yig ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi spyan yangs mkhan chen shar pa rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa'i zhal sngar phul ba'i tshe bris pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yantu/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i mi mchog rnams kyi mkhyen rab dang*// thugs rje byin rlabs chu yi gter las yang dag byung*// yongs kyi re skong chos kyi nor bu bla na med// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i thor tshugs mdzes par rgyal gyur cig /bde bar gshegs bstan mkha' yi bu mo'i 'gram pa dag /mdzes byed sprul pa'i rol rtsed zla nyi'i sgra 'dzin rgyan// dge legs mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor 'od zer bye ba g.yo// skal ldan snying gi chu skyes 'dren byed kun dga' ster// sems can mos pa'i yol go tha dad rab gdangs par// rjes su 'tsham par de de'i thabs kyi zil mngar ni// gzhar yang 'jo la 'dzad par mi 'gyur ya mtshan gang*// mngon par sprul byed las kyi byed po de re mkhas// gtsug lag rab 'byams chos kyi ltad mo rdzogs pa dag /mong rtul tshogs su rnam par 'phyan na mi rung zhes// gang gi mkhyen rab dri med ngos su ma 'dres par// shes bya kun gyi rgyal po des ni bkod min nam// gting mtha' dpag par dka' ba'i ngo mtshar dag byed gter// nges pa min no mkhas btsun khyod kyi rnam par thar// bsam kun rdzogs byed de yang nor bu'i rgyal po zhig /ma yin ci 'dod lhun gyis grub pa'i yon tan no// dran pa'i dbang po la 'os bsam yas legs mdzad mtha'// ring du song ba tshad la blang phyir legs bris lam// rang lus tha gru yangs par sprul te nyin mtshan gyi// mgon po re mos bsrel nas blta ba yin snyam byed// mtsho ldan lus phra rab tu dgyes skyed yi ge'i glu// lam gsum 'khod pa'i blo ldan yongs kyis 'drir byas kyang*// nyung ngur mi bgyid yon tan phung po zung dag gi

/zhabs stegs dam pa'i chos kyis mtho gyur de drung du// 'di na sa bdag rigs kyi rkang 'thung rgyas gyur pa// de las skye ba'i lcug phran gzhon nur gyur pa des// dad gus lo 'dab gsar pa'i khur bus dud pa bcas// dga' ba las skyes gleng mo'i me tog 'dzum gyis bsu// de'ang rnam 'dren bstan pa gsal ba'i sgron me/ shes bya ma lus pa mkhyen pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po/ si tu rin po che chos kyi 'byung gnas pa zhes rnam dkar grags pa'i zla 'od gsar pas/ phyogs dang khor yug gi nor ldan brtan ma'i bzhin ras yangs pa gsal bar byed pa'i mchog sprul chen po nyid/ bstan dang 'gro la sman pa'i thugs bskyed kyis lan brgyar bskul ba bzhin du/ bsil ldan ljongs kyi yul dbus phyogs su chibs gyi kha lo bsgyur ba nyes med du son par gyur cing*/ der bzhed don gyi snying po rgyal ba karma pa zhwa dmar sprul sku rin po che gdon mi za bar zhal gyis 'ches ltar bdag gir mdzad de/ bstan pa dam pa'i bdag por 'jigs bral seng ge'i khri la mnga' gsol/ bal yul tshur rol gyi gdul byar gyur pa'i skye 'gro mchog dman rang rang gi skal bar 'tsham pa'i chos kyi snang bas/ gnas skabs mthar thug gi phan bde'i 'bras bur 'god pa sogs legs mdzad gang la rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dgyes pa'i mchod sprin chen po bskrun te/ slar yang ji skad du/ rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung*// smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ bskal pa dpag tu med par thugs bskyed dang smon lam bzang por goms stobs kyi shing rta la legs par bcibs te/ 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon dam pa padma rā ga zhun ma'i cod paṇa 'chang ba chen po sa phyogs 'dir spyan 'dren mdzad pa gang dang*/ gnas lnga rig pa smra ba yongs kyi gtsug rgyan chen po ste skyabs mgon nyi zla zung 'brel du gyur pa'i gzugs sku mthong don che ba dag

deng dus ma hā bho ṭa'i yul gyi lus can spyi'i bsod nams mkha' la gegs bral du shar ba dang*/ sgos su mkhas shing grub pa'i sa la gnas pa'i skyes chen du ma'i zhabs kyis bcags shing bshad sgrub kyi snang ba dam pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gdan sa chen po lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab 'dir/ 'khor los mtshan pa'i zhabs kyi rdul phreng gtsang mas nye bar btab pas shis pa'i cho ga phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs te/ kho bo cag gi lta byed kyi dbang po'i yul na lkog tu ma gyur par mchod yon zhal 'dzom gyi ngo mtshar bla na med pa dang chab cig legs gsungs 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi'i btung bas/ bdag rgyud bsod nams kyi skal ba mi dman par bskrun pa sogs gang cir sku drin blo 'das su che ba'i ya mtshan gang de rin thang tshad du bgyir btub na/ stong gsum zong gi rnam par song yang cha shas bsgrub tu ci zhig ldong*/ 'on te rang nyid dad dang spro ba brtas pa'i lhag bsam gyis kun nas bslangs te/ 'dir dus gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa'i bdag nyid chen po zung gi sku zhabs su legs so'i 'bul ba mtshon byed du/ bkra shis re khās spud pa'i lha dar sogs tshan grangs lhag bcas sa skyong kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho can gyi phul bar rtag tu thugs rje'i spyan ras kyi gzigs pa dam pa'i rwa ba las mi bor bar gsol ba 'debs so zhes karma pa zhwa dmar sprul sku dang*/ si tu rin po che lhan cig spyan 'dren zhus pa'i legs 'bul gyi gong bshad du bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yantu/ bskal bzang

yan lag gcig gzugs/ 'dren pa bzhi pa yi// chos kyi rgyal mtshan brtan byed du// mkhas pa'i phrin las mi zad dpal// 'byung gnas dam pa rgyal gyur cig /smon ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ lam yangs brdal mkha' dbyings las// legs par 'ongs pa'i sgyu 'phrul zla// gnas lnga rig pa'i sa mos tshal// bzhad pa'i rtsa lag bla na med// gzhung don nges pa'i dpe/ rab 'byams legs bshad kyi// glu ru jo ba rin chen phreng*// 'dren 'di lam gsum 'bab kyi rgyun// mtshungs las gzhan pa'i dpe zla bral// bai dharba'i mdzes pa'i yon tan/ thos bsam bsgom pas sbyangs pa'i thugs// gang gis dpyad pa'i mdun sa ru// khengs pas bsgyings pa'i shes bya ni// zab dang yangs pa gnyis la med// sems can mos pa'i snyim pa ni// sna tshogs phyogs nas gdengs pa dag /tshul bzhin 'gengs pa'i yon tan 'di// dpag bsam ljon pa'i rjes su 'gro// sde bya ba tha ma'i gsal byed/ snod gsum gyis bstan bya ba// snying po sdom pa'i lam chen gyis// 'gro ba byang chub smin byas pa'i// phrin las phyogs bral kun du bgrod// kun cha shas can gzugs/ gyi mnyes gshin thugs rje yi// dkyil 'khor yangs ldan 'gro ba 'dis// ngal gsor spyod pa'i gling dam par// mi 'gyur bteg pa'i khri drung du// kun mkhyen rang bzhin brjod pa/ shākya seng ge'i bka'// rjes su bsgrub pa'i 'dun pa dag /ma lhod tsam gyi dge sbyong pas// shis pa'i gnas 'dir 'di skad gsol// 'di skabs su bab pa'i gleng ba rnams yod kyang 'dir ma bris so// zhes pa 'di'ang si tu sprul skur 'bul ba stob pa'i gong brjod du don gnyer gyi ngor bande tshul rin gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// bi dza yantu/ kun mkhyen thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings las// phrin las mchog sprul nyin mor byed// dus 'dir rgyal bstan 'dab stong tshal// bgrang yas bzhad pa'i gnyen mchog dang*// skyabs song bslu med dkon mchog gsum// kun 'dus bdag nyid gtsug lag brgya// yongs bzung mkhas pa'i tshul gsum gyis// legs par 'doms pa'i dbang phyug ste// mchog zung zhabs kyi mtsho skyes dag

/yid can mgon du bskal pa'i phreng*// brtan byed chos kyis mtho ba'i khri// dregs ldan gdong lngas bteg pa'i drung*// dad gsum shugs bskyed ba spu'i tshogs// rnam par g.yo mdzes snyim pa dag /yan lag mchog tu lan cig min// ngal gsor spyod snyam 'di skad gsol// tshogs zung lhun po'i phrag las thon// dge legs mtshan bzang dkyil 'khor las// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od zer stong*// 'jig rten dge legs gsos su spro// rab 'byams gzhung lugs srid do 'tshal// mgrin las 'jo ba'i thub chod 'dis// shes bya mtha' med grags pa'i sgra// chung ngur bgyid snyam 'di rigs sam// zab yangs shes bya'i dkyil 'khor che// rdzogs par khyed kyi mkhyen klong du// dogs pa med par chud pa'i mtshar// blo ldan kun yid blta phyir rgyug /phyogs bral sems can re ba'i snod// sbyin bzhi'i dpal gyis bder 'gengs par// srid pa'i dpal tsam ster bzod pa'i// dpag bsam yongs 'dus ci ste 'gran// rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i lung rtogs bstan// sman 'dogs rmad byung legs mdzad kyi// zla snang gsar pa'i pho nya yis// phyogs kyi pha mtha' gzhal ring nas// zla bral skyabs gcig mchog gi sku// snying brtse'i shing rtas legs drangs te// bdag cag sdum par zhabs rdul phreng*// gtsang mas btab pa'i skal bzang bsgrubs// khyad par mthong ba'i chos 'di la// legs nyes slob pa'i blo gros ni// brtan ldan 'od srungs byin gyi mched// rkyen dbang nyer song sgrib sbyong du// phyir bzlog dbang bskur thugs rje yi// 'od zer zhags pas rjes bzung nas// gnas bzang bstan pa'i bka' drin lan// 'jig rten byed pos blan dka' gyur// de lta na'ang brnab sems rgya// dad 'dun skyes bus yongs dral te// gtang rag maṇḍal bkod pa la// spyan zur lhung ba'i mtshon byed du// thog mar bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i gser sku sogs rnam grangs brgya phrag zung 'di bkra shis rgya mtsho spun gyis phul ba lags/

smras pa/ sngon las byed po khengs ldan gyis// nyer sprul 'khor ba'i mtsho nang du// dpal 'byor ge sar rgyal mtshan can// nyung zad bskrun pa'i mchod pas mtshon// dus kyi chos nyid thim gang gi /gnyen 'brel ltos dang bcas rnams kyis// bsags pa'i legs byas stong gsum gyi// 'jig rten maṇḍal sprul ste dbul// dge ba rgya mtsho dmigs yul mtshon// sems can rgya mtsho byang chub bar// mchod 'os rgya mtsho mnyes byed cing*// legs gsungs rgya mtshor spyod phyir bsngo// zhes rgyal ba zhwa dmar mchog sprul rin po che dang si tu sprul sku chos kyi 'byung gnas lhan cig par brgya phrag zung gi 'bul ba stob pa'i gong gsham gyi gleng ba nyung ngu 'di'ang gnyer pa bkra shis rgya mtsho'i gsung gis bskul ngor bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan gyis gtams gang mtshan tambu raḥyi dbyangs// su zhig thos 'dzin dpyid du sim pas srid dang zhi ba'i dge legs skyes// ci yang 'gugs pa'i thugs rje'i shing rta rnam kun yangs ldan dkon mchog gsum// deng 'dir mthun min phyogs las rnam rgyal shis pa'i me tog stsol la spyon// grangs med bskal pa'i phreng bar legs sbyangs mkhyen rab me long gtsang ma der// ji snyed chos kyi gzugs brnyan brgya phrag legs par 'phos pa'i 'phrin yig gis// ches cher bsngags pa rgyal tshab chen po dran pa'i dbang po kun dga'i dpyid// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i spobs pa bzang po brgyud par bcas pas dge legs stsol// phyogs bral zhing gi stobs bcu mnga' rnams mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ti la ka /mtha' dag gcig bsdus mang du thos pa'i yid 'phrog lang tsho dar bab mas// mtha' klas chos kyi rig byed 'byin po'i snying gi brtan pa yongs phrogs nas// byang chub lam gyi rtse dga' la sbyor dpal ldan bla ma rgyal gyur cig

/'jaṃm dpal dbyangaṃs nyid smon lam sa bon rma med kyis btab zhing sa ru// yang dag choṃs kyiṃ tshul chen smra ba kun gyi blaṃ maṃr mngon du 'phags// rdzogs sangaṃs rgyasaṃ kun yeṃ shesaṃ snang ba 'dzad med gter gyi sgo 'phar 'bum// cig car 'byed pa'i mtshan nyid kun gyis nye bar spud pa'i ngo mtshar gter// dge tshogs rin chen lhun po'i phrag pa nas// legs par shar ba skyabs kyi zla ba gang*// rgyal bstan sa la dga' ba'i me tog tshal// 'dab stong bzhad pa'i gnyen du khyod rmad byung*// brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos kun mtsho ldan ma// dgyes skyed tshig gi lam nas 'dren pa la// sgrun du med pa'i ngo mtshar la blta phyir// mkhas rnams blo ni khyod drung rgyug pa bzhin// shes bya'i rang bzhin rnam par yangs pa'i mtha'// byed po gzhan gyis cung zad bstungs min par// mkhyen klong yangs pa gcig tu tha dad nyid// gsal bar 'god 'di thub chod las min nam// ris bral sems can re ba gang dang gang*// de des 'gengs pas bsam 'phel nor bu'i mchog /gtong phod che ba'i yi ge 'gog snyam du// chu gter chen po'i klong du song ba bzhin// legs pa'i phrin las lam gsum 'bab ma yis// bstan dang 'gro ba'i mi mthun dri sbyangs nas// phan bde 'dzad pa med par dbyar gyi dus// rin chen 'byung gnas chen po'i spun zlar byas// mngon mtho'i bde 'byor spel ba de gcig gis// byang chen spyod pa'i rjes su bsngags min yang*// grangs med bskal par 'thob dka'i snying po mchog /ster ba'i thabs la mkhas pa 'dis kyang ngo*// zhabs sen dmar ba'i 'od rdul lha dang mi'i// thor tshugs nor bu 'bar bar ngal 'tsho'i gnas// bgyid pa chos kyi rkang stegs gdong lnga pas// 'gyur med mngon par bteg pa ga la bar// dad 'dun thal sbyar me tog dkar po'i 'dzum// ci yang ngom pa'i dal 'byor sdong bu'i phang*// blo yi rkang pa drug ldan mgrin pa nas// zhu ris snyan pa'i dbyangs chung 'di skad 'bul// zhes shis par brjod cing phyag bya'i tshig gi phreng ba 'ga' zhig gis sngun bsu ste/

skabs su babs par gleng ba/ rje btsun dam pa nyid nged cag spun zlar bcas pa'i sngon las bzang po'i shugs kyi shing rtas legs par drangs pa'i bla'i mchod gnas dam par me tog phog pa'i lha skal du nye bar thob pa nas brtsams te/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba dang rjes su gnang ba la sogs pa chos kyi bdud rtsi'i rim pa bsam gyis mi khyab par stsal ba'i sgo nas gnas skabs mthar thug 'bras bu'i sgo 'phar yangs por phye ba'i bka' drin gyi mu mtha' 'chi med lam gyi gting mthas kyang mtshon du yod par ma gyur cing*/ bdag cag rnams nas kyang 'di nas byang chub bar gyi blo gtad 'cha' ba la mi phyed pa'i dad 'dun gyi rtsa ba brtan par tshugs thog 'dir/ rje btsun dam pa nyid dbus gtsang phyogs su cis kyang bteg dgos kyi bka' 'phrin lan grangs su stsal yang rang gi dad mos dang dgos pa che gshis/ 'byon pas chog pa'i zhu 'bul ci yang ma spobs pa de ltar lags/ slar yang 'di lor mi 'byon thabs med lta bu'i bka' nan che bar bcas// phebs chog pa'i zhu 'bul zhig ni mi byed dbang med du song ba de'i gtan tshigs kyang*/ da gzod 'brug lo'i nang 'di gar cis kyang phebs grub rtsis kyi zhu gsung gor ma'i ri mo lta bur bgyis pa de bzhin lags/ da lan gong 'phros ltar chos dang dam tshig gi drin la dpag na 'dzam gling gser gas bkang yang sku drin cha shas kyang 'tshob pa lta ci zhig 'on kyang deng skabs dus nam dang rgya bod kyi sna len sogs gang ci'i 'gan 'degs lci ba dgongs bzhin/ rgyal khab 'dir dngos rdzas kyi mdzad sgo che stabs 'bul nod rgya dpangs che ba zhig stob thub pa ma byung zhing*/ gal te byung na rang rgyud du tshogs rdzogs chen por 'gyur ba yang*/ ji skad du/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i// ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur// zhes sogs mang du bsngags pa cung zad mthong thos yod rung de tsam zhig ni ma byung song yang*/

deng 'dir sngon dus byang chub sems dpa' kha cig a ru ra'i gong bu tsam phul te byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa dper blangs pa'i 'bul rdzong mtshon byed du bkra shis lha dar gyis thog drangs pa'i rnam grangs brgya brgyad phul ba brtse bzhes dang*/ ye shes gzigs pa'i khongs nas nam yang mi bskyud par gsol ba 'debs na ci gnang*/ smras pa/ dad mos blo yi bang mdzod grol ba las// byung ba'i dngos po 'dis mtshon dge ba'i tshogs// mtshor bcas sa gzhi ri gling nyi zla sogs// phun tshogs dpal 'byor sprul pas khyod mchod do// ba spu'i skye ba'i gnas rer mchod byas pa'i// bsod nams rgyu skar lam las ches 'byams pa// mtshan ldan rdo rje slob dpon mnyes byed pa'i// las su skal bas bskos 'di legs byas sbom// grub par mdzod cig deng nas byang chub bar// ye shes gzigs pa'i 'bab stegs bdag rgyud du// brtan par 'cha' ba dngas mtshor zla gzugs ni// 'gog pa min ltar smon pa'i lam 'di'o// zhes 'jam dbyangs chos kyi bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes pa dbus gtsang phyogs su bteg pa'i skabs sku rdzong 'bul ba'i gong brjod gleng bslang bcas 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// // ༄༅// srid pa gsum na zla bral ba// yon tan tshogs kyis mtho gyur pas// lha yis bsngags pa'i me tog char// grangs med bsnyil de rgyal gyur cig /gtsug lag rab 'byams blo gros kyi// snang ba dam pas gsal bgyis pa'i// ngo mtshar gang gis nyin mor byed// phyogs re'i mun pa'i gshed du song*// kun la legs snyoms thugs rje'i dpal// 'od srungs byin gyi dkyil 'khor dang*// re zhig mthun mod byang chub mchog /de srid rten du khyod drin bzang*// gangs gsum byin rlabs zla ba'i zer// legs 'thungs skal bzang dga' tshal du// mngon mtho nges legs sa dga'i tshal// 'dzum brgya 'grol ba'i nus pa rdzogs// kun mkhyen dam pa'i zhal gyi lung*// mngon par rtogs bcas rtsa lag tu// ji srid bskal par g.yung drung gi

/go 'phang nyid du brtan gyur cig /de skad rtse gcig rab gus pa'i// blo gros me tog bzhed pa las// shis brjod bung ba'i dbyangs chung gis// mdun bsu nas ni 'di skad gsol// spyir gtan gyi skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams/ bsu ba dang skyel mar phyin pa'i rnam smin zhabs mthil 'khor los mtshan pa la sogs pa rnam par smin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul la legs par bsams na/ deng rje btsun dam pa thugs rje'i gter nyid kyi sku'i phebs skyel du mdo gzhung gi sa'i cha tsam du bdag gis kyang slabs pa zhig byung na phan yon dpag tu med pa rang la 'byung bar nges mod/ deng dus nam zla zhan pa'i stabs kyis mi ser rnams la dka' tshegs che ba'i rgyur 'gro ba dang*/ kho bo cag gzugs po 'khrang che ba zhig kyang ma mchis pa dang*/ 'dir yang khang pa'i bzo bkod byed pa'i 'gan 'degs dgos pa bcas/ chibs skyel ring po zhig tu sleb pa ma byung bar dgongs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po las rnam 'gyur gyi rlabs phreng mi 'phyo zhing*/ slad kyi char yang 'jig rten kun gyi bden pa'i dpang po'i mthar thug pa ni bla ma'i bka' yin pa ltar/ da gzod stag gi lo ngo'i da lta'i dus tshod las mi 'phyi bar/ da lta ji lta ba bzhin du zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal ba'i skal ba bzang po las nam yang mi g.yel bar gsol ba 'debs pa dgongs pa'i dbyings su 'dren pa mkhyen mkhyen/ slar yang smras pa/ bden dpang kun gyi yang rtse ni// bslu med bla ma'i bka' zhes pa// bden pa des kyang gus ldan pa'i// bsams kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol// zhes pa sangs rgyas ye shes gtsang phyogs su bteg pa'i chibs skyel dus gleng ba 'di ltar dgongs tshul sa skyong bla ma kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho nas bka' stsal phebs bzhin bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis gleng ba'o//

// ༄༅// swasti bi dza yantu/ mtha' dag gzugs can/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i chos tshul 'chi med tshal// mdzes byed rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob dpag bsam dbang*// ngo mtshar mkhas tshul skyong ba'i lo 'dab dang*// bzang po'i snye ma g.yur za'i zhabs stegs su// chab bsdus shing ma bsdus gzugs/ srid stobs 'byor 'dab ma brgya pa'i bcud// 'thung la rig pa'i bung ba cher g.yengs kyang*// byang chub nam 'phang bgrod 'dod ma bskyungs pa'i// sa bdag rigs kyi gzhon nus 'di skad gsol// bskal yan lag gnyis gzugs/ pa'i chu gter la bsgrubs legs byas rnams// 'gro don dus su bab pa'i lag pa yis// gcig tu legs bsdoms skal bar 'tsham pa'i skur// ngo mtshar bskrun pa'i byed po de re mkhas/

rmongs pa'i dpe/ /legs gsungs gdams pa'i zil mngar kun gyi gsos// bar med 'gyed la tshigs bzangs gzhon nu rnams// rang gi 'tsho ba nyid du rnam brtags nas// sngo bsangs lam du rgyu zhing blta ba snyam// rnam mang bai dharba'i rgya che ba'i yon tan/ shes bya'i ltad mo bkrag tu cher// mkhyen pa'i tshul 'dis rin chen khang bzangs ngogs// ra wa ṇa yi gzugs brgya cig car du// snang byas ngo mtshar sngon rabs grags pa tsam// bgrang yas rab rtogs/ rgyal ba'i rigs dang dkyil 'khor gyi// khyab bdag tshad ma'i slob dpon de ni khyod// yong ye bsngags pa'i 'os su rgyud lung gi /ming tshig yi ge'i cang te'u 'khrol ba snyam// rab rtogs/ rnam dkar phrin las brdal legs dkyil 'khor gyis// tha gru yangs pa'i pha rol 'gro 'gyur gyi// dgos pa rmad byung des ni rigs byed 'byin// stong gsum yangs par sprul la nges par zhugs// gsang go ṭa pa'i mdzes pa/ chen theg pa mtha' dag mgrin 'jo ba'i// rdo rje'i bla ma che ba'i ya mtshan gtam// rdzogs par smra la ma drug skyes yin yang*// 'phrin yig khur pos ngal ba mi 'gyur grang*// dngos dpe/ kun mkhyen bstan pa'i mdzes byed dam pa khyod// gsang ba mi shigs zho 'thung rus las skyes// rdo rje'i do zlar byed pa'i cho ga ni// 'jig rten mgon po kun gyis sgrubs shig kye// blo ldan rgyal ba'i sras rnams zhing sbyong dang*// sems can smin byed sgyu 'phrul dpag med las// theg mchog rdo rje slob dpon sprul gang la// dngos phran 'dis mtshon sgo gsum dge bas mchod// skyed byed kyi rgyu/ des bskyed dge ba'i nus pas mgon po khyod// rtag par 'tsho gzhes chos kyi rgyal po'i lugs// yang dag skyong ba'i rgyal tshab mchog gyur nas// phyogs bcur chos kyi snang ba 'gyed pa dang*// bdag

ldan pa'i gzugs can/ kyang byang chub snying po son bar gyi// tshe rabs kun du rgyal ba'i myu gu'i rigs// mi dman skye ba'i sdong bu bzung ba'i rtser// bstan 'gror phan pa'i snye mas dud par shog / yan lag gsum gzugs/ snyigs ma'i brlang spyod sbrul gdug kha yi rlangs// dkon mchog thugs rje'i zhi byed sman mchog gis// bran pas yul gru 'dis mtshon rgyal khams dag /bde skyid legs bris dga' ston spyod gyur cig /ces mchod brjod snyan dngags kyi phreng ba nyung zad sngon du btang nas skabs su bab pa'i gleng ba/ deng rje btsun dam pa nyid kyi rigs mchog shing sā la chen po lta bu'i khu bor gyur pa/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams bzang po pa de nyid snyigs ma'i dus kyi rgyal bstan gsal bar byed pa'i snang byed chen por gyur cing*/ rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i ring lugs la lan gcig min par phan stobs chen po byung ba'i sku drin la bsams na 'phags pa dang so so'i skye bo'i blo ldan su yang dad pa'i chu gter rnam kun 'phel bar mi 'gyur ba ci zhig sgos su mkhan chen de nyid kyi sku dbon sngon bsags bsod nams shar ri'i dpung rtse nas 'phos pa'i 'dren pa dam pa'i gzugs sku'i kun phan gzhon nu nyid/ las bzang gser gyi shing rtar bcibs te/ mdo smad ljongs pa'i lus can spyi'i skal ba bzang po'i mgron du khugs shing*/ gang 'tsham gdul bya'i re ba mtha' dag legs par bskangs te/ slar gtsang phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba'i dgongs pas/ da lam mkhan po bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen po'i zhal bzangs kyi dkyil 'khor mjal zhing gsung gi bdud rtsi'i bgo skal bzhes pa dang*/ bdag cag rnams su'ang shis brjod swasti'i sgra brnyan brdung slad/ phyogs 'di'i nor 'dzin zhabs kyis bcags pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba che ltar/ kho bo cag nas kyang dbang lung gdams pa'i bdud rtsi bsten cing zhag grangs mang shas shig bsnyen bkur stob pa'i 'dun pa che na'ang*/

rje nyid la 'byon chas nyer bsdogs bstar ba'i thugs brel yod pa dang*/ bdag kyang gang ci'i bgyi ba mang po'i g.yeng brel ma chod gshis de tsam zhig ni ma byung song*/ 'on kyang deng gi long skabs rjes su dpags pa'i dbang bka' rjes gnang zab mo 'ga' zhig gi bka' drin stsal ba'i gtang rag dang*/ phebs rdzong gi mtshon byed chab cig par bkra shis lha dar gyis thog drangs pa'i tshan grangs smos pa 'di dag gus par phul ba lags/ zhes pa khang gsar sku dbon rin po che chos skyong bzang po dbus gtsang du bteg pa'i skabs/ phebs rdzong gi gong brjod dang gleng ba cung zad 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris so// // ༄༅// swasti/ dge legs 'byung gnas bstan pa'i dga' tshal dag /mdzes byed tshul khrims dag pa'i bsung zhim gyis// 'khor ba'i gdung chen dbrog pa'i cho ga mkhan// skyabs mchog ljon pa'i dbang po'i zhabs drung du// bgrod dka'i gnas kyis rnam par bskal gyur kyang*// bsngags 'os phrin las dkar pos rmongs chen blo// dbang med de ru drangs par ma bzod nas// gus spro 'phrin gyi lam nas 'di skad 'bul// rnam mang skye bar bsags pa'i legs byas tshogs// gzugs can nyid du mngon par lhags pa'i sku// gdul bya'i gtsug na rtag par bkod pa'i mtshang*// ma bzod zla ba bde 'byung gtsug na bros// phyi nang gtsug lag rab 'byams gtam gyi sgor// rtag par 'jo yang mthas gtugs dben pa'i tshul// rin chen 'byung gnas las gzhan mtshungs pa'i zla// 'os gyur srid pa gsum po gang du btsal// drang dang nges pa'i shes bya kun gyi gzhi// ma 'dres mkhyen klong yangs par rnam bkod pa'i// bgyi ba 'dis ni rmongs chen skye bo yi// dran pa'i sgo mangs ma byin blangs kyis dogs// gcig tu mi'am ci las ma byung zhing*// dpal ldan dge dbang nyid kyang ma yin par// snyan dngags ro ldan gsung mchid rten dang bcas// snying gi mun sel 'di ko ji ltar thob// dga' ba'i ro des myos pa'i bdag lus la'ang*// 'phreng gegs sbrul gyi kha rlangs ma ldang bar// sgo gsum dge bar sbyar 'dod re ba ni// dar gyi srad bu bzhin zhig ma chad tsam// phrin las 'od snang spro byed sku'i zla ba// rnam 'dren gnyis pa'i lung rtogs rnam 'phyo'i grong*// rnam par 'phel ba'i gnyen du mi nub par// brtan byed thabs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pa nas// nags su gzhan gyis gsos pa rgyas pa'i glu// skye bo'i snying gi bde ba ster nyid na// smra ba mkhas pa'i mgrin las lam thams cad// snyan dngags dbyangs su 'phos na cis mi dga'// de skad smra ba'i yi ge'i bya ma rtas// stong 'khun yul du bskrun pa'i gos bzangs gyon// bkra shis rtags kyis nyer mtshan rin chen gyi// 'khor lo du ba'i skye gnas grangs ldan bcas// sde bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i 'byung gnas su// grags pa'i dge mtshan srid pa 'dir gsal ba// gang de'i gandho la dang nye ba nas// gus ldan kun dga' lhun grub can gyis phul// ces pa ngor gyi dpon slob dbu mdzad kyi drung du 'bul ba'i zhu yig bya ma rta'i ngag snyan zhes bya ba 'di ni kun dga' lhun grub kyi ched du bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge'o//

// ༄༅// thub dbang bstan pa'i mtho ris skyed tshal du// tshul khrims dri ldan 'dab stong 'dzum dbus nas// lung rigs bung ba'i glu 'dis mkhas mang gi /yid kyi rigs mthun mdza' bo 'gugs byed drung*// chos srid mkhyen pa'i 'byor pas ches dbul yang*// ring nas 'grogs pa'i rmongs chen snying grogs khos// dam du 'khyud de rnam g.yengs bza' ba 'gas// bsnyen bkur thob pa'i phran bus 'di skad gleng*// sngon song legs byas stong gi rnam smin 'bras// smin cing dud pa'i gzugs sku'i rkang 'thung mched// 'phral 'tshe'i dri bzhon phyogs gzhan nyul ba'i tshe// rnam dpyod me tog dkar mdzes ngom pa nas// sdeb sbyor lus stobs rgyas pa'i legs sbyar gyi// rkang gdub sgra 'khrol nyams 'gyur tshig gi glus// kun dga' bskyed pa'i gsung shog ngang mo dkar// lha reg gis mtshon rten gyi sgro gshog can// 'byor tshe rig pa'i khye'us bka' drin gyi// pha mtha' lan mang bcal bas ma mngon par// ngo tshas lus kyi lkog tu yib pa la// so phreng tshogs rnams khrel nas dgod min nam// 'dir yang don gnyis nor bus yongs dben pa'i// 'byung lnga'i shing brtsegs lus kyi gru bo che// nyer 'tshe'i chu srin gdug pas ma gtses par// lhag bsam dkar po'i ba dan 'dzugs pa'i khul// sngon chad drin gyis re ba rdzogs tshul 'ga'// smra bar sems kyang 'dod pas ngom bral 'dis// slad mar gzugs sku rnam gnyis 'tsho ba nas// phebs tshogs chad med stsol zhes tshig 'di thon// snyan tshig mgrin pa'i sgra 'byin tambu ra// brdungs pa'i zhu yig rkang drug gar mkhan ma// spyan zur padma'i do rar 'jug 'dod nas// rten phran 'dab ma'i rgyan gos bklubs te song*// zhes pa 'di'ang lhun grub steng gi bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug pa sku mched la 'byor lan rkang drug dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba 'di'ang e waṃ chos ldan gyi ldan khang padma dkar po nas bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o//

// ༄༅// dpal ldan ngag gi dbang phyug srid pa 'dir// chos mig rab yangs skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// mkhas tshul phrin las rmad byung dpal stug gi /lugs bzang 'jig rten snang byed rgyal gyur cig /deng gi skye dgu'i las bzang skya rengs kyis// nyer drangs bsod nams brgya pa'i gzugs sku'i nyi// rgyal bstan kun gsal 'gram par legs spud tshe// phyogs bral phan bde'i 'dab brgya cis mi 'dzum// skyabs gnas 'dus pa gang gi mkhyen nus brtse// yangs par phyin pa'i dpe zla nga nyid la// nges par mchis snyam mkha' khyod rgyags mi 'tshal// kun mkhyen ye shes mtha' bral gyis kyang 'gran// sna tshogs las pas lan 'gar bdar min pa// mthong na mi mthun med sku'i mi sbyin skyes// bgrang yas bskal pa'i yun du ris bral gyi// sems can rtsa lag mi shigs brtan ched du// 'dzam bu nyal 'gro'i rin chen kañtsa na// legs bris bzo bos bskrun lta'i chos kyi khri// stobs 'byor dregs ldan bye ba'i thor tshugs rtses// lan gcig min pas btud pa ga la bar// mtho ris rten gyi rkang 'thung ldem pa'i phang*// don gnyis snye ma g.yur du za min yang*// lhag bsam me tog dkar po 'dzum dbus nas// zhu ris rkang drug dbyangs chung 'bul ba ni// rnam 'dren bstan pa'i snang byed dam pa nyid ris bral 'gro ba'i spyi nor chen po nyid du bzhugs pa gor ma chag mod/ deng dus 'bri klung dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram ngogs kyi lus can rnams kyi skal ba dam pa'i mgron du khugs pa dang*/ mthong don mi dman zhal bzang snying rje'i lag pas phyis pa gang de/ gyi na pa de'i 'dren byed zung gi dga' ston du nye bar nod pa'i sku drin gsob mtshon du/ dar dkar/ ling yug lwa ta yug ras yug dngul srang*/ wa lpags/ rta pho bcas pa 'di dag zhu dag bla mar btags pas phul ba lags/ zhes lcags ra sprul sku rin po che ngag dbang phrin las dpal bzang par phul ba'i zhu yig tu bris pa'o//

// ༄༅// rnam 'dren bstan pa'i zhi bsil khang pa ru// las bzang bgo skal theg pas nyer drangs nas// klog spong las kyi 'khor los dus 'da' ba// yon gnas bag yod 'dus pa mchog gi drung*// 'khor ba'i phun tshogs dbyar skyes 'khrig pa'i mngal// mngon par ldem pa'i dal 'byor rkang bas 'thung*// bsam bsgom snye ma smin pa'i khur dman yang*// thos pa'i lo 'dab g.yo bas 'di skad mchid// srid pa'i rims nad 'phrog la ring chas pa'i// bslab khrims bag yod spyod pas rgyud gtams shing*// theg mchog bdud rtsi'i dga' ston phyogs bral du// 'gyed pa'i ngo mtshar phrin las rna ba'i dpyid// gang tshe ma lus rgyal ba dgyes bskyed pa'i// dge la yi rangs zla 'od gsar pa'i 'dzum// brgya phrag grol ba'i nyams ldan tshig gi phreng*// lha rdzas dar dang khro bzang g.yag bcas dang*// chab cig rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel rnams// ljongs der gdan 'dren bgyid pa'i grogs ldan gyi// mthun rkyen ma tshang med pa'i mdzad bzang 'dir// skye 'phags kun gyi mthong thos ngo mtshar dpyid// 'dir 'khod snyom las pa yang 'byung tshogs kyi// spyil chung 'phral gyi 'tshe ba'i dri bzhon de// mchog gsum thugs rje'i sa 'dzin dbang po yi// bag la zha ba'i bde dga' spyod pa'i skabs// slad du'ang 'dus tshogs mi ltung phreng ba dang*// ngos mjal spro ba'i 'od dkar 'thung bzhin du// lung rtogs bstan pa'i mkha' la lhan 'dzom pa'i// bkra shis rol mo rgyal kun 'khrol bar smon// de skad bdag yid dga' ba las skyes tshig /theg gsum gdams pa'i rna lung yangs pa'i klong*// smin ched dar sman ling yug wa sbre dang*// gzig lpags rin chen gnyis pa zhor bcas 'di// mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug nyi zla ltar// yongs su grags pa du ma'i gsang gsum gyi// byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i thigs pas legs bran pa'i// lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab zhig nas phul// zhes pa sa dkar bsam 'grub gling gi 'dus tshogs su phul ba'i zhu yig kun dga'i zla ris zhes pa 'di'ang bande tshul rin gyis so//

// ༄༅// chos dang srid gzhung thos pa'i sgra 'dzin yangs// rnam par dpyod pa'i lta byed zung gis mdzes// gcig tu 'gro la byams brtse'i 'dzum dmul ba// grogs bzang dbang po'i zhal skyin de drung du// mngon dga'i yid kyi dkar 'jam shog bu'i gzhi// mthong ba'i 'phral la snag smyug zung dag gis// nyer spud lag pa'i zlos gar yi ge'i gzugs// bsgyur ba spyan gyi dga' ston cis mi 'gyur// rnyed dka'i dal rten mthor chos gzhan dbang gis// res 'ga' g.yengs kyang chos spyod mi 'dor ba// dpyid dus ser bus bskyod kyang ku su ma// ge sar tshogs kyis dgod bzhin mdzes las tshe// 'dir 'khod chos smra'i gzugs kyi ba ku la// skyabs gsum thugs rje'i mtshar sdug 'gram chang gis// dga' spro'i 'dab ma dal bus grol gang tshe// bzlas brjod sbrang rtsi'i gdangs snyan 'byin pa'i skabs// de skad mchid bu nyung zlos yi ge'i tshogs// kun dga' khong nas rgyas pa'i dbyangs can glu// len par spro ba'i 'dzum zer dar dkar gyi// sngags mdud kyis g.yob gser ldan ljongs nas thal// zhes slob bu a gdon pa la phul lags// // ༄// sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛtta phreng ldan mar ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyi dgongs par chig stong nyer bzhi mchis pa'i khyad par gzhung gis dngos bstan min pa'i naṣṭa dza ya re ba dang lci bar uddiṣṭa chig brgya zhe gnyis pa'i prāstā ras mdzes par byas pa'o// ༄༅// guṇāṇabatsessāwaṃshapūrṇaṇohṛdādwayalakṣ+myātpannamāyā/ bhawaṃyubanassandhirdharāgrāgatīyatsadhamaḥpādapadme// ༄༅// yon tan rgya mtsho gdung 'tshob bcas pa'i thugs// gnyis su med dpal las 'khrungs sgyu ma'i 'phrul// srid par thun mtshams lang tsho 'dzin mchog gi /chos dang sems can sman mdzad zhabs padmor// mchid du gsol lo phyogs der mgrin snyan bteg /dad dga' lhan cig skyes pa'i 'dzum dmul bas// zla bral chos kyi sku drin rnam bsams kyin// tshigs bcad phreng du bstar ba'i snyan dngags kyis// tshogs zung rgan las thos pa'i mdzub rtse yis// dge mtshan gzugs brnyan bris pa bkrag che ba'i// skyabs kun 'dus pa nam mkha'i rna ba gang*// bstan 'dzin mi ltung phreng ba'i khrod na gsal// gsang chen chos kyi dga' ston ris bral 'gror// bar med 'gyed pa'i mtshar la mi bsngags te// mkhas tshul gsum gyis bstan pa'i las byed pa// smra mkhas chen po rnams kyi las yin phyir// dbyangs ldan lus phra dgyes pa'i snyan dngags pa// bye bas brjod kyang 'dzad min che ba'i cha// rin chen 'byung gnas che las bskal pa'i phreng*// chab rgyun blangs pas mthas gtugs nam zhig mthong*// gang tshe bṛtta dzā ti'i sdeb sbyor mtsho// bsrubs bcud mnyam pa'i yi ge bcu gnyis khrod// sna tshogs lha mo'i zla tshes sar pa yis// tshigs bcad dpal mgrin ral par mdzes par spud// rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur legs sbyar gzhung*// byed po phur bu gser mngal yi ge'i dbyibs// brdzus nas dkar 'jam ngos gzhir lhags so zhes// dpyod ldan rus pa'i ge sar 'dzum zhing dgod// thams cad mkhyen rgyu gtsug lag rig pa'i gzhung*// ma lus lam srol zung dang rgyan gsum glur// 'jo ba'i thub chod 'di kos shes bya'i gnas// mtha' klas grags pa bstungs par ma gyur grang*// gtsug lag rig pa'i gzugs dang gzugs brnyan dag

/rnam par dpyod pa'i shes rlom dga' byed kyi// blo yang som nyir brten tshe dpyad gsum gyis// smra mkhas añdza na bu khyod nyid khums// chos 'dul las byung gnang bkag bslab pa'i gzhi// rgyas min ngag gis 'doms pa'i tshul 'di 'dra// sngon chad byas pa ma dran yon tan 'od// 'gyod pas snyigs ma'i dus 'dir lhags sam snyam// theg chen mdo don rang dgar 'grel pas khyod// smra mkhas 'phags pa'i rjes su snyeg min yang*// mtha' drug dgongs bzhis rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi// dgongs don 'chad pa'i mchu 'dab snyung 'dis kyang*// blo chen skal ba mchog gi rigs can rnams// bgrod bya rdo rje 'chang sa ga la bar// son pa de srid mtshan rtog sgrib kun las// yid skyob rdo rje'i rgyas btab bgrod pa'i thabs// rgyu rgyud rang bzhin dag pa'i sa bon gang*// smin grol thabs kyi sdong bu bskyed bsrings rtser// mchog dngos grub pa'i snye mas dud de yang*// lhun grub gnas gyur 'gal med smra la sgrin// grub pa chen po'i go sa'i 'od srungs byin// dkyil 'khor mtha' dag sngags spyod gom gcig gis// skad cig gcig gnon mtsho las skyes pa yi// rdo rje'i 'jug pa bcu ldan thugs kyi bcud// bka' gter zab chos mtha' dag thos dang bsam// bsgom byung shes rab rnon pos dpyad pa'i mdun// ches cher zab brling khengs pas bsgyings pa yi// shes bya'i dngos 'ga' yong med 'phyang mo nyug /gang tshe 'phrin du shod byed gandharba'i// glu dbyangs len mas dar dkar gos su gyon// 'od 'bar gser gyi rna chas mkhur tshos zung*// rab mdzes lang tsho'i rgyags pa ngom gyin 'byor// ngo mtshar 'dzad du med pa'i ltad mo la// lta byed rnam par g.yengs dang lhan cig nyid// bdag yid kun dga' rgyal ba'i 'dzum dkar gyis// bzhin gyi dri ma lan brgyar bkru bzhin mchis// 'di na 'byung lnga tshogs pa'i 'dam bu'i khyim// 'phrang gegs gnyis 'thung dregs pas ma gtses par// gzhan dbang rnam g.yeng rlung gis bskyod pa'i nang*// gzhan phan sems kyi skyes bus ma bor tsam// slad char bstan 'gror sman pa'i rtsa lag gang*// lhun po'i gzugs sku lam gsum rgyun gyi gsung*// kun gsal mkhyen pa dpag bsam yon tan dang*// zla snang dkar po'i 'phrin las rgyas pa nas// phyogs bral dad pa'i chos don gnyer bdag dang*// gsang chen chos tshul 'doms pa'i dbang phyug khyod// phan tshun chos kyi khud pas sbrel legs pas// re ba'i shing rta snying pos 'geng bar smon// 'phrin shod mkhas pa'i mgrin pa'i rdza rnga can// dar dang gos bzang sgro gshog ches g.yo zhing*// dngul dkar dong tse'i skyes bcas nyid mdun gyi// legs bris yul gyi mtsho skyes rdzing bu'i nang*// 'bru mang bod pa 'byung ba gsum ldan gyi// skyes bu stag shar rtse 'jos bskyed pa'i bu// ma drug las skyes zhag gi phung po gang*// dar bab rgyal ba gnyis pas bsu dus thal// zhes ze chen rab 'byams pa padma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pa nas gsung yig snyan dngags dri za'i rgyud mangs las 'phos pa rten dang bcas pa stsal ba'i zhu lan 'phrin shod mgrin pa'i rdza rnga zhes bya ba 'di ni bande tshul khrims rin chen nam/

ngag gi dbang po phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sder btags pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa'o// // ༄༅// phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun yon tan gyi// bkod pa ji snyed smon lam mthus// gcig tu spungs lta'i skyabs kyi mchog /bskal par brling byed chos kyi khrir// zla zhun gyis bskus mgo skyes rtser// zhabs sen 'char ka'i nyi 'od rdul// 'bab stegs bgyis pa'i bka' 'bangs bdag /kun dga'i 'dzum bcas 'di skad gsol// gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi mdzod// grub pa gang zhig rdo rje 'chang*// mtshungs las deng dus gdul bya'i ngor// ngur smrig 'chang skur snang bas dbye// ma bris dge mtshan lhun grub sku// ma brdal rgyal bstan yangs pa'i rgyan// ma bteg lha mi'i gtsug mtho yang*// ma 'dris 'gro ba'i bgo skal du// bsod nams pho nyas nyer drangs pa'i// sngon med kun dga'i dpal 'di slar// gzugs sku bskal par 'tsho gzhes tshe// thob kyi gzhan las nam yang min// bgrod dga'i ngal brgyas ma mnar zhing*// gzhal dka'i rin gyis bsgrubs min par// brgya lam bskal par rnyed dka'i skyabs// bde blag nyid du thob pas 'tsheng*// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi sgo// ma bsdams rtag tu gdangs pa gang*// gegs bral gtsug tu son pa'i drin// dri khyer lam gyis mtshon du ci// 'on te bgres mos zas gtsang sras// snang gsal phul rjes lung bstan ltar// dngos rdzas phra mo maṇḍal sprul// gus pas phul ba brtse bzhes gsol// bkra shis pa'i lha dar dkar pos thog drangs pa'i bcu bdun tshan 'di bka' 'bangs zhus dag bla mas phul ba lags/ zhes mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong pa dbus gtsang phyogs su bteg pa'i bzhed don thams cad grub nas/ slar mdo khams 'gro ba'i don du sde dge lhun grub steng gi phan bde gling gi bla brang du gegs bral phebs pa'i legs 'bul gyi tshe ched brjod maṇḍal 'bul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di'ang bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/

// ༄༅// swasti bi dza ya tu/ rab 'byams zhing gi rnam par 'dren// gsang gsum yon tan bsam mi khyab// gcig tu gyur pa'i skyabs yul mchog /zung gi zhabs stegs ga la bar// sa skyong rigs kyi rkang 'thung ni// dad gsum lo 'dab g.yur za bas// thal sbyar me tog dgod pa'i khrod// zhu gsol khu byug dbyangs chung 'bul// bgrang yas tshogs zung dag byed gter// smon lam dus bab ri'i dbang pos// bsrubs skyes sku yi snang byed dag /rgyal bstan kun gsal rgyan du gsal// mtsho byung dga' mas srid zhi'i dngos// snyan dngags rgyud mangs sbreng bzhin par// longs spyod 'khor lor yib min na// ci 'dod legs bshad 'jo 'di ci// shes bya'i gzhung lugs srid do 'tshal// chud par dog bral mkhyen rab mtha'// gzhal phyir 'chi med rdzing ring mas// rang 'dom yangs por sbrul gyis ngogs// lus can mos pa'i yol go dag /phyogs rnams kun nas gdengs pa dag /de de'i dngos pos bder 'gengs pa// rgyal rnams yon tan rjes su snyeg /mi mchog dgyes bskyed phrin las bzang*// zla 'od dkar pos phyogs bral gyi// bstan 'gror phan bde'i sa dga'i tshal// cig car bzhad pa'i tshul la rangs// snyan dngags smra ba mkhas dgu yis// bskal par brjod pas 'dzad min par// yon tan phung po zung gi sku// 'gro khams mos pa'i shing rtar brten// ris bral bstan 'gror phan 'dogs kyi// dgongs bzhed chibs kyi kha lo dag /gang du bsgyur der gegs dben cing*// bzhed don lhun gyis grub pa dang*// mi ring ljongs kyi thig le 'dir// nyer bcags bdag cag ltos bcas 'gros// legs gsungs bdud rtsi'i bcud 'thung ba'i// skal bzang bskrun pa'i maṇḍal mtshon// lha dar dkar po sogs bri'o// zhes rnam 'dren karma zhwa dmar ba dang si tu sprul pa'i sku dag 'jang yul du chibs bsgyur gnang ba'i dngos po'i khud pa 'bul ba'i gong brjod 'di bzhin dgos zhes sa dbang bsod nams mgon po ba'i bka' lung phebs 'phral du bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi phan gling bla brang du bris pa'o//

// ༄༅// oṃ bi dza ya tu/ phyogs bral rnam 'dren ji snyed kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i chu gter las// legs 'khrungs chos kyi snang byed dag /bskal brgyar brtan byed seng ge'i khrir// dad gsum yid kyi rdzing bu'i nang*// thal sbyar utpal dmar po'i phreng*// mdza' bas sbrel snyam gtsug bkod pa'i// sa skyong phal gyis 'di skad gsol// skyon bral ngur smrig 'chang mchog gi /gzugs sku gang 'tsham sprul pa'i gar// phun tshogs mtshan bzang bskrun byed pa'i// bsod nams byed po de re mkhas// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi tshul// mtha' dag rgyan gsum lam yangs nas// 'dzad med 'dren pa'i ngo mtshar gtam// gleng la phur bu'i blo yang ngal// thos bsam bsgom pas legs sbyangs blo// bzhin snod gcig tu shes bya'i yul// rdzogs par chud pa'i thub chod 'dis// mtha' bral chos kyi grags pa bsdud// sems can re skong zung dag gi /yon tan 'dzad pa med dpal la// 'gran par ma nus kostu bha// legs bris bgo skal brdzus te song*// rnam dkar phrin las zla gzhon gyi// snang ba dam pas phyogs kyi bzhin// yangs par song pa'i 'phrin snyan yang*// gyi nar bgyid pa zung dag gi /zhal bzang mthong don che ba'i zla// lta byed bdud rtsi'i dga' ston du// 'thung zhing legs gsungs thar pa'i gsos// blang phyir lhags pa'i sa skyong bdag /ltos bcas rnams kyi zang zing dngos// snying por byed pa'i maṇḍal gyi// brda mtshon nyung zad dbul bya'i grangs// tho chung bris pa 'di ltar lags// lha dar dkar po sogs bri/ ces dpal spungs karma zhwa dmar ba dang si tu sprul pa'i sku rnam pa gnyis kyi zhal mjal 'bul tshan gyi gong brjod bung ba'i dbyangs chung zhes pa 'di'ang hor phur thog dpon gyi gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa bkra shis// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti bi dza yantu/

padma rā ga'i lhun por 'od brgya pas// lan mang 'khyud pas mtshon min gzi byin gter// tshe mtha' yas pa'i rgyal bas sa skyong mchog /sku srog bskal par 'tsho ba'i dngos grub stsol// lhas bskos sa bon rma med kyis bskrun pa'i// bsam kun rdzogs byed ngur smrig 'chang gi sku// chab srid 'chi med dga' tshal shis pa'i rgyan// sde bzhi'i snye mas dud bzhin ches brling shog /tshangs dbyangs 'bum sde'i snyan 'gyur srid do cog /las bzang byed pos gcig tu spungs pa lta'i// snyan 'jebs gdangs las 'khor 'das chos rnams kun// snyan dngags glu ru rtag 'jo'i shis pa sgrubs// shes bya'i gzhung gi mgrin bcu blo gros kyi// ha nu manthas rnam dpyad dka' ba'i gnad// 'bigs byed mkhas pa'i 'phong rkyen ra ma ṇaḥ// mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal gyur cig /zla bral las dbang 'khor lo sngon 'gro bas// dpag yas dbyig 'dzin dkyil 'khor mnga' sgyur la// bsngo bas rnam dben bsod nams khri 'phang du// brtan byed cho ga rgyal kun sgrubs shig gu// 'gro 'dis legs byas rkang mgyogs grub pa'i mthus// blang dor dpyod pa'i 'dren byed stong ldan lha// 'jig rten dge legs mgron du gnyer byas pa'i// chos mthun spyod pa'i sa skyong bla ma che'i// zhabs zung bandu dzī wa ka'i spun zla// brtan par bkod pa'i rkang stegs rin chen gyi// me long dwangs pa'i ngos su che dgu yi// bzhin gyi gzugs brgya snang ba ga la bar// rnam dkar phra mo'i mdza' na'i g.yab mo yis// dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i mgron du gnyer byas pa'i// dge sbyong gzugs brnyan la zhugs gyi na bas// skabs su bab pa'i mchid bu 'di skad 'bul// deng dus zham ring rgan bu gnas skabs kyi// dgos pa che min 'gab phyir rang yul du// nyer son 'phral la ljongs kyi thig le 'dir// bde bar 'byor pa'i snyan gsan 'bebs mtshon tsam// sngon chad sbyin pa'i chu rdzing 'khyil ba'i nang*// dngos rdzas phra mo'i me tog bzhad pa las// nyung zad btus pa'i mdun 'jog rnam pa'i grangs// yi ge'i lam nas 'dren pa 'di ltar lags// de skad sa skyong bla ma che'i// sku mdun legs bris chu skyes tshal// phul ba'i zhu ris rkang drug dbyangs// tshul khrims rin chen zhes byas phul// zhes sa skyong bla ma chen po blo gros rgya mtsho pa'i sku zhabs su/

bde bar 'byor ba'i snyan gsan dang mjal dar chabs cig stob pa'i shis brjod dge legs 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
